{{Quote|Its alien builders, the Rakata, called it the Eternity Vault; it's where they kept the prisoners and technology they could never afford to release.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Threnoldt]]|audio=Threnoldt-EternityVault-TOR.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Eternity Vault''' was a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] located on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. It contained ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] technology and prisoners that were hidden until they were uncovered during the [[Great Galactic War]]. Unfortunately, this also gained the attention of [[Soa|The Infernal One]], a powerful [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] who was imprisoned in the Vault for as yet unknown reasons. A volcanic cave was located in the cavern wall between the vault's primary [[Prison/Legends|prison]] block and the vault's jungle zone. During the [[Galactic War]], when the Eternity Vault was breached by bombing, the [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] known as [[Gharj]] broke free from its imprisonment in the prison block and ripped through the back wall of its cell, and made its home in the lava cave. Gharj was later slain in the cave.

==Behind the scenes==
The Eternity Vault is featured in a mission in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
